subject: Staggered exec attendance plan & VP/CIO intro for Noventis demo
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@noventis.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Noventis Procurement <procurement@noventis.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + exec coverage for Redwood demo

Markus —

Thanks for taking this on. We’re excited to see the Redwood demo next week. My VP of Engineering (Raj Patel) and our CIO would like a short executive intro before the product walkthrough so they understand the business case and high-level architecture. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 

- A 45-minute product walk-through with a short 15-minute exec intro at the top (VP level)
- A follow-on 30-minute technical deep-dive for our CIO (can be the same meeting with a staggered join)
- An NDA in place for slides and a one-page mutual action plan / procurement next steps

Our procurement team (cc’d) will need a SOW and pricing ballpark to move internal approvals — happy to accept draft docs after the demo. Suggested windows (Pacific):
- Tue Aug 2: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Aug 3: 09:00–10:30

Can you propose how Redwood would cover the exec escort and who from your team should be present? Also note our CIO prefers to join for the deeper technical segment only if possible.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Senior Product Manager, Noventis
Samantha.li@noventis.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + exec coverage for Redwood demo

Samantha —

Really appreciate the clear ask. We can absolutely support a staggered attendance flow that matches how your execs want to engage. My proposed plan below is designed to minimize calendar overhead while giving both the VP and CIO the experience they need.

Proposed meeting structure (90 minutes total):
- 0–15 min: Executive intro (Markus Klein, Director of Sales) — business outcomes, deployment modes, SLAs
- 15–60 min: Product demo (Laura Bennett, Account Lead) — live walkthrough oriented to procurement questions and integration points
- 60–90 min: Technical deep-dive / Q&A (Ben Carter, Solutions Engineer) — architecture, security/compliance, deployment options for VPC/on-prem

This lets your VP attend the first 30–45 minutes (exec intro + product highlights) and your CIO join at 60 minutes for technical discussion, or join earlier if they prefer.

Availability: we can do Tue Aug 2 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed Aug 3 09:00–10:30 PT — both work for our team. I’ll hold Tue 10:00 as our tentative slot unless you confirm otherwise.

I attached a one-page demo agenda and an exec intro slide deck (stubs) so you can share with Raj and procurement: demo_agenda_v1.pdf; exec_intro_slides.pdf.

Also cc’ing Laura (account lead) and Ben (SE) so they have context and can prep any technical artifacts. If procurement needs a draft SOW ahead of the demo we can provide a short template and pricing ranges.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm which time you prefer and whether Raj will attend the first 30 or full exec intro.
2) Confirm CIO preferred join time (straight into 60–90 min block or earlier)
3) I’ll send a calendar invite with staggered guest expectations and dial-in details once we lock time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Markus Klein
Director of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Attachments: demo_agenda_v1.pdf, exec_intro_slides.pdf

Thanks Markus — that structure works well. Raj will attend the first 40 minutes (exec intro + product highlights) and the CIO will join at the 60-minute mark for the technical session. Please treat Tue Aug 2 10:00–11:30 PT as confirmed for Noventis.

Procurement (cc) — could you take a look at the attached agenda and NDAs once Markus sends them? We’d like a draft SOW and ballpark pricing after the demo; if Redwood can surface typical Dedicated vs Hosted unit economics that will help speed reviews.

One quick ask: please include a short mutual action plan (one page) with key milestones so I can present this to our steering committee immediately after the demo.

Cheers,
Samantha
